name: Sasahara Nonoka
source:
Favorite subject: English
Hobbies: Bird watching, collecting bath salts
Favorite food: French Toast
Hated food: Oysters

A third-year student who is a member of the Pottery Club. Nonoka works part-time as a waitress at a local bakery/restaurant owned by her grandfather. She's allowed to eat all the cake she wants, but it will be taken out of her pay.
